intro: Trying to find Illinois scholarships tied to financial need without wading into the highest award tiers? This filtered slice brings together USA listings with posted awards under the stated cap, so you can compare options that may feel more realistic to apply for alongside other aid. The rows below span areas such as education, STEM, community, medicine, disability, and miscellaneous topics, with examples that reach from nursing and cultural diversity to sustainable communities. Requirements are not identical across these programs: some may be lighter touch, some may ask for more documentation, and essay expectations can differ by listing. Deadlines also vary by row, so it is smart to check timing early if you are building a shortlist for the current cycle.
